description.zh:
要查询自定义Header的域名。

> 您可以调用[DescribeDomains](~~91724~~)查询所有已接入DDoS高防防护的域名。
description.en:
The domain name for which to query custom headers.

> You can call the [DescribeDomains](~~91724~~) operation to query all domain names.

description.zh: DDoS高防实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。
description.en: The ID of the resource group in Resource Management to which the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance belongs. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo describe-headers --resource-group-id rg-aek3cmuvpia0000 --domain example.aliyundoc.com --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
